verdict.rationale: relay-docs-3 explicitly claims receipt capture and real-time categorization synced to accounting software, directly matching the story, but this is vendor claimed-docs with no independent/hands-on corroboration of the automatic, no-manual-entry experience at point-of-card-use. Missing for 10: independent verification of receipt capture working automatically at time of card swipe, detail on how receipts are captured (e.g., email forwarding, app photo, or true automation vs. reminder prompts), and community confirmation of the coding accuracy.
